Juniper Mist is a cloud-native, AI-driven networking platform that provides APIs for managing wireless, wired, and SD-WAN infrastructure. The Mist API enables full lifecycle management of sites, devices, WLANs, clients, and analytics through a RESTful interface. It supports organization-level and site-level management with token-based and OAuth2 authentication.
